summary: DexCom filed an 8-K disclosing a new $1.0 billion share repurchase program authorized by its Board, replacing a prior program with $250 million remaining. The program expires June 30, 2027, and allows open-market, privately negotiated, or Rule 10b5-1 plan repurchases under Rule 10b-18. Terms include no fixed price per share or premium; it is an open authorization. No financial advisor or recommendation was detailed. The filing also covered investor day materials and long-range financial targets under Items 7.01 and 8.01. Watch for execution pace and potential EPS accretion; no arbitrage angle in an open-market buyback.
